notes: Short dark cut of the floating light shelf from Rameez's own phone clips (IMG_7745 polish / IMG_7747 track / IMG_7749 three). Story: unlit plank -> the line comes on -> three lit -> three on a wall. Hook 'watch this plank turn into a wall light.' scores 11/12 (gap/truth/pull all pass). Grade is the measured S1 override, not the noir style default: this footage sits at p5=32-60 luma, so the style's brightness -0.30 / contrast 1.50 crush buries the plank; this lifts the toe with a curve and keeps the dark look with contrast + vignette. Closing shot is the approved AI-generated wall render (hf/gen-three-on-wall-a-9x16.jpg) - the only frame showing the product installed; paid placement needs Meta's AI disclosure. Slow-motion dropped from the closing pull: minterpolate (mci/aobmc) was the dominant render cost on a 4-core box and the shot reads fine at speed.
